warmup.description: Ease into movement with a gentle, relaxed walking pace.
movements: Slow walk with relaxed arms x 3 minutes

main_exercises.name: Recovery Walk (Relaxed Steady Pace)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Very low intensity zone 1-2 (around 50-60% effort), where breathing is effortless and fully conversational
main_exercises.form_cue: Walk with relaxed posture, natural arm swing, and soft, steady steps

cooldown.description: Gradually slow down and transition into full rest with mindful breathing.
movements: Standing still with deep breathing x 1 minute

phase_notes.menstrual: This recovery walk is highly supportive—keep pace very gentle and focus on fresh air and relaxation rather than distance or speed.
phase_notes.follicular: Use this as an easy baseline activity to stay consistent—keep it light and avoid turning it into a workout.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Even if energy is higher, keep this session intentionally slow and restorative—focus on recovery rather than performance.
phase_notes.early_luteal: This walk helps maintain movement without adding fatigue—keep rhythm steady and relaxed.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Ideal for reducing stress and supporting mood—focus on calm breathing and a comfortable pace throughout.
